customer_generation.prompt: Create a polished, portrait-oriented pet portrait featuring the exact same dog from reference image 1, named {dog_name}. Image 1 is the identity source of truth: preserve this dog's recognizable face, muzzle, eyes, natural ears, coat colors, markings, fur length, and age. Image 2 is the selected artwork design reference. Recreate its costume, props, color palette, artistic medium, lighting, and scene as closely as practical, adapting everything to a real dog's anatomy and proportions. Style: Asteroid Prospector. Design notes: mining utility coat, asteroid station. Show one complete dog with a natural canine head and body, no humans, no second animal, no text, no watermark.

source_art.prompt: Create one premium full-bleed pet portrait template, vertical 4:5, cinematic fine-art realism, detailed natural fur, beautiful sophisticated lighting and coherent realistic materials. Use the reference golden retriever's recognizable natural canine face. Exactly ONE dog, no people or additional animals. A real dog wearing a well-fitted dog-tailored costume, natural canine body, shoulders and paws; never a human body, hands, breasts, cleavage, corset, human hips or human muscles. Feminine designs only use clothing and accessories over natural dog anatomy. Large clearly visible face, both eyes sharp, natural ears completely inside image with 12% top breathing room. Front or slight three-quarter portrait; head unobstructed for later pet identity replacement. Hats behind ears, goggles or helmets beside dog when they would obscure the face. Props rest beside the dog, never held with human hands. No lettering, logos, watermark, collage, picture frame or printed caption. Distinct attractive setting, costume and composition specific to this concept. Collection: Retro Futures and Original Characters. Portrait: Asteroid Prospector. Scene and costume: mining utility coat, asteroid station.

Use the reference dog's natural face and markings. Exactly ONE dog in the scene. Dog face large, clearly visible, front or three-quarter view, eyes sharp; entire ears inside the image with comfortable 12% top breathing room. A real dog wearing dog-tailored costume, natural canine shoulders, chest, body and paws. NO human body, NO human hands, NO human characters, NO lettering, NO watermark, NO frame mockup. Scene: Dog in orange utility jacket with brown straps and red scarf, sitting beside a yellow and black tool case on a metallic deck, surrounded by floating asteroids and a futuristic space station in the background, rendered in cinematic sci-fi style with warm lighting and reflective surfaces. recipe.instruction: Match the original individual face exactly: muzzle length, skull, eye shape, ears, age and asymmetric markings. Keep the face naturally lit and attached to its own neck. Every visible animal surface must use the ORIGINAL dog coat distribution and texture, including forelegs, paws, hindquarters and tail. The erased template animal contributes no coat information. Rebuild a connected body at the original dog's breed, age and build. Fit the costume to that body. Use compact rounded canine paws with short grouped toes, no long fingers or human hands. Respect perspective and genuinely hidden limbs. Preserve the intended reference pose with this dog's own natural limb proportions and posture.
